regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation with AI Infrastructure still in first place but fading (val_state 'fading', durability 0.68, breadth 0.708) and no one-narrative regime (one_narrative false, absorption 0.31). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge (gate_helps true), so any lean must be conditional on that gate holding; the momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0). Macro backdrop is noisy (75% unscheduled share), so no macro catalyst is supported.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity's perfect breadth (1.0) and high crowding resolve into a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Infrastructure — I would retire this watch if AI Infrastructure's breadth recovers above 0.8 while Cybersecurity's breadth drops below 0.7 (no handoff underway).

theses.subject: Cybersecurity

The crowding flag (z 1.8, crowded true) is a size-down caution, not a fade; the bullish case rests on broad participation and trend persistence rather than rank alone.
evidence: crowded true (z 1.8) as sizing caution only

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is a top-4 eligible theme with trend tag (hurst 'trend'), decent breadth (0.727), and no crowding stress (z 0.83). The absolute-trend gate is the validated drawdown-control leg, and energy sits comfortably above its durability bar with a stable dispersion, giving it a cleaner trend-following character than the AI cluster which is fading.
theses.dissent: Energy is highly macro-sensitive to oil supply shocks and geopolitics; the 75% unscheduled macro share means a headline-driven reversal could hit without a technical warning, and momentum rank alone has no alpha.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own 20-day low while remaining above the absolute-trend gate

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure still leads the rank but shows fading momentum (val_state 'fading', hurst_tag 'mixed') and a durability bar that is middle-of-pack (0.68). The rotation read confirms a non-directional, one-narrative-false structure with AI infra absorbing attention without breadth confirmation. This is an avoid on the leader, not a fade — the detector explicitly warns not to short the dominant theme.
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure remains the highest-momentum, highest-weighted headline theme; fading it has historically been the documented failure mode, and avoid may miss continued absolute-trend participation.

falsifier.text: SMH makes a new 20-day high with breadth recovering above 0.8 before the check-by date
